item.title: States are trying to unlock solutions for reentry housing
item.description: For people with criminal records, research shows stable housing reduces their likelihood of committing another crime. Ohio and a handful of other states want to change that and are offering a kind of guarantee to landlords. item.title: Despite slow gains, Cradle Cincinnati continues to drill down on ways to decrease infant mortality
item.description: The infant mortality rate, or the death of an infant before its first birthday, continues to remain high among Black families.
